name: Robert Boyle
contribution: An Anglo-Irish chemist, alchemist, physicist, theologian, and inventor.

checks.lead: Robert Boyle (; 25 January 1627 – 31 December 1691) was an Anglo-Irish chemist, alchemist, physicist, theologian, and inventor. Boyle is largely regarded today as the first modern chemist, and therefore one of the founders of modern chemistry, and one of the pioneers of modern experimental scientific method.
